    classDef endpoint fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:white
    classDef service fill:#2ecc71,stroke:#27ae60,color:white

    %% API Endpoints
    subgraph NASA_API
        E1["GET /telemetry/stream"]:::endpoint
        E2["GET /telemetry/status"]:::endpoint
    end

    subgraph Lightstreamer_API
        E3["WS /lightstreamer/create_session"]:::endpoint
        E4["WS /lightstreamer/bind_session"]:::endpoint
        E5["WS /lightstreamer/control"]:::endpoint
        E6["WS /lightstreamer/destroy_session"]:::endpoint
    end

    %% Services
    NASA["NASA ISS Telemetry Service"]:::service
    LS["Lightstreamer Service"]:::service

    %% Connections
    NASA --> E1
    NASA --> E2
    LS --> E3
    LS --> E4
    LS --> E5
    LS --> E6
